text: SQL aur NoSQL mein difference kya hai?

AI matlab Artificial Intelligence Yeh basically computer systems ya machines ko insano ki tarah sochne, sikhne aur decision lene ki capability deta hai taaki wo complex tasks khud kar sakein. Aur SQL aur NoSQL databases ka difference yeh hai: **Structure:** SQL relational databases hote hain jo data ko tables (rows aur columns) mein store karte hain NoSQL non-relational hote hain jo data ko JSON-like documents, key-value pairs, ya graphs mein store karte hain. **Schema:** SQL ka fixed schema hota hai matlab pehle se define karna padta hai ki data kaisa dikhega. NoSQL ka schema dynamic hota hai, tum kabhi bhi naye fields add kar sakte ho bina purane data ko affect kiye. **Scaling:** SQL databases vertically scale hote hain (matlab ek hi server ki power badhana padti hai) NoSQL databases horizontally scale hote hain (matlab naye servers add kar sakte ho data handle karne ke liye). **Use cases:** SQL complex queries aur transactions (jaise banking apps) ke liye best hai NoSQL un jagahon pe use hota hai jahan data fast change hota hai aur unstructed hota hai (jaise real-time analytics ya big data).

text: 2 + 2 kya hota hai?

Okay, suno. SQL aur NoSQL databases ka main difference yeh hai: SQL databases jaise MySQL ya PostgreSQL, structured hote hain. Inmein data tables mein store hota hai, rows aur columns ke saath. Ek fixed schema hota hai, matlab data ka structure pehle se define karna padta hai. Yeh relational databases hote hain aur consistency ke liye achhe hain. NoSQL databases jaise MongoDB ya Cassandra, unstructured ya semi-structured data ke liye hote hain. Inka koi fixed schema nahi hota, toh yeh flexible hote hain aur alag-alag formats mein data store kar sakte hain (jaise documents, key-value pairs, graphs). Yeh scalability ke liye achhe maane jaate hain. Basically, SQL structured data ke liye, NoSQL flexible data ke liye. --- Ab React aur Vue ka difference: React ek JavaScript library hai jo Meta (Facebook) ne banaya hai UI (User Interface) banane ke liye Yeh component-based hota hai aur JSX (JavaScript XML) use karta hai apne templates ke liye. Iska ecosystem bahut bada hai aur kaafi popular hai. Vue.js ek progressive JavaScript framework hai jo Evan You ne banaya tha Yeh bhi component-based hai lekin HTML-based templates use karta hai, jo kai logon ko easy to learn lagta hai. Iska learning curve React se thoda kam mana jaata hai. Dono hi modern web applications banane ke liye achhe hain bas approach aur philosophy thodi alag hai. --- Aur 2 + 2? Yeh toh 4 hota hai. Aur phir se 2 + 2? Woh bhi 4 hi hoga.
